name: plus_eq_add
prelude:
def plus : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | n, 0 => n
  | n, m + 1 => plus n m + 1
statement: theorem plus_eq_add (n m : Nat) : plus n m = n + m
proofs:
induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => simp [plus, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  have zero_left (k : Nat) : plus 0 k = k := by
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => simp [plus, ih]
  have succ_left (a b : Nat) : plus (a + 1) b = plus a b + 1 := by
    induction b with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ b ih => simp [plus, ih]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [zero_left]
  | succ n ih => rw [succ_left, ih]; omega
strategies: Induction on the recursive second argument m.
Induction on n after proving zero-left and successor-left helper lemmas.
